subject: Avery — Compliance follow-up: audit logs, retention, DPA, pen test
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avery-enterprises.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Avery — Compliance follow-up: audit logs, retention, DPA, pen test

Hi Samir — thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Pain points you called out:
- Need for detailed audit logs (per-request, per-user) stored for at least 12 months and searchable by incident ID.
- Clear data retention policy and the ability to configure shorter retention for sensitive buckets.
- Corporate DPA and a redlines conversation before procurement can proceed.
- Proof of recent pen test and remediation notes (especially around token leakage and S3 access controls).

What we covered on the call:
- Redwood architecture for request-level audit logging (elastic+S3 + retention lifecycle policies).
- Options for customer-managed KMS and VPC/private deployment for regulated workloads.
- Typical SOC 2 scoping and what evidence we can provide during sales (policies, config screenshots, control mappings).

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send you a short bundle with: DPA draft (v3), the latest pen test summary, and a sanitized sample of our audit-log export.
2) You’ll confirm required retention period and who should sign the DPA on your side.
3) Schedule a follow-up technical session for your infra/security team to walk our audit log format and KMS options.

Would you be available for a 45-minute technical call on Wed 6/17 or Thu 6/18?

Attachments I will include: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf, pen_test_summary-redwood-2025.pdf, and a small \"avery_request_summary.pdf\" with the fields you asked for.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: avery_request_summary.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avery-enterprises.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Avery — Compliance follow-up: audit logs, retention, DPA, pen test

Vanessa — thanks, that summary is useful. A few clarifications from my side:

1) Retention: legal wants 12 months by default; security wants a way to set 90 days for ephemeral projects. Both need to be enforceable by policy (not just a UI setting).
2) Audit logs: we need IP, user-id, request-id, model-version, and response-hash for 400/500 responses. Export should be CSV/JSON and consumable by our SIEM.
3) Pen test: do you have a redactable version of the 2025 pen test report that we can share with our outside counsel? If not, a summary + mitigation timeline will do.
4) DPA: legal will review; they usually redline sections on subprocessors and data deletion guarantees.

We can do Thu 6/18 at 10:00 AM PT for the technical deep dive. Please include folks from product security and whoever owns the audit-log schema.

Also: attach a quick example of the log schema so our SIEM team can vet it before the technical call.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Security Operations, Avery Enterprises
samir.patel@avery-enterprises.com
+1 (212) 555-0122

Samir — attaching the bundle we discussed. Thanks again for the prompt feedback and for committing time for the technical session.

Included in this email:
- redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (DPA draft, marked with comments on subprocessors and deletion SLA)
- pen_test_summary-redwood-2025.pdf (sanitized summary; full report available under NDA)
- avery_request_summary.pdf (small sample mapping fields to an exported CSV/JSON)
- requested_log_schema_example.json (example schema and a short CSV example)

Short answers inline to your bullets:
- Retention enforcement: we support retention policies enforced via lifecycle rules at the bucket level when using Redwood Private or Dedicated; for Hosted customers we provide policy enforcement and a managed lifecycle control plane with tenant scoping. We will provide an auditable policy attachment for legal.
- Audit log fields: we can output IP, user-id, request-id, model-version, response-hash, response-status, and a timestamp. Exports are available in newline-delimited JSON and CSV.
- Pen test: attached is the redacted 2025 summary and a mitigation timeline for the four medium findings. To share the full report we require an NDA; we can push an NDA via DocuSign if needed.
- DPA redlines: Monica — I flagged likely redlines in the DPA (subprocessors, data deletion; see comments). Can we have an initial legal touchpoint next week?

Next steps (agreed):
1) Technical deep dive with Avery infra/security — Thu 18 Jun 2026, 10:00 AM PT (I’ll send calendar invite).
2) Monica to start DPA review and reach out to Avery legal to collect redlines (owner: Monica).
3) Connor to share the formal log-schema examples and retention policy docs in our shared Drive (owner: Connor).
4) If Avery needs the full pen test report, we’ll route a DocuSign NDA and, upon execution, deliver the full PDF (owner: Vanessa).
